cover.title: How to get the Urban Kiz glide
cover.subtitle: 4 moments  ·  4 cues to practise

moments.headline: Soft knees, level head
moments.try: Walk with a book on your head. If it wobbles, soften your knees and move from the hips.

moments.headline: Stop together
moments.try: Leaders: stop by breathing in through the chest, not by braking with the feet.

moments.headline: The lead starts in the chest
moments.try: Hold a scarf between your chests and travel 8 steps. If it drops, the connection opened.

moments.headline: One shared axis
moments.try: Turn slowly in place, imagining a single pole between your two bodies.

closing.title: Feel the half-beat
closing.body: This track runs at about 123 BPM, and their steps land on the half-beats. Start with one step per beat. Double it only when it feels effortless.
closing.bonus: Film yourself from the side, phone on a tripod. The camera shows what the mirror hides.
closing.button: Save this for your next practice
